items.picture: Registration at the conference, in a busy foyer: an organiser with a lanyard welcomes Tomáš and hands him his name badge; other participants queue at the desk behind them.
Tomáš gives his talk in the conference hall, standing at a lectern beside a big screen showing a chart; the audience listens in rows, Emma among them.
Split picture of a phone call. Left: Emma, cooking in the dorm kitchen, holds up an invitation card as she tells her news. Right: Emma's mum, at home in Ireland, listens, delighted.
At the conference registration desk, Emma fills in a form on a clipboard while a smiling organiser with a lanyard waits with her badge.
Coffee break at the conference: people with badges crowd round a long table of cups and pastries. Tomáš balances a coffee and a croissant while chatting to Emma.

items.text: Teším sa na konferenciu. = I'm looking forward to the conference.
Emma got an invitation. How does she say it?

items.picture: Tomáš frowns at his office computer screen, full of folders and file icons, hunting for one file.
Two halves at Emma's laptop. Left: she double-clicks and a document opens on the screen. Right: she clicks it closed and folds the laptop shut.
Late at night at her dorm desk, Emma clicks save on her finished paper and slumps back with a huge sigh of relief.

items.text: kliknúť na ikonu = to click on the icon
items.picture: Close-up of Emma's hand on a computer mouse; on the screen the pointer hovers over a bright, colourful icon on the desktop.

items.text: kopírovať a vložiť = to copy and paste
items.picture: At the dorm desk, Lucia shows Emma how to copy a chart from one window and paste it into her slides; Emma leans in, following on the laptop screen.
In the office at Tomáš's company, Tomáš waits by the printer as the pages of his talk slide out into the tray.

items.text: poslať e-mailom = to send by e-mail
items.picture: Lucia, at her laptop in the dorm room, sends an e-mail with a file attached; a bubble shows the friend it's for, at her own laptop far away, receiving it.
Two halves. Left: Tomáš in the shower, washing himself. Right: Lucia at the bathroom sink, washing just her hands.
At the counter of the university's international office, Emma bends over a long printed form full of empty boxes, pen in hand.

items.text: Vypíšte, prosím, dotazník. = Please fill in the questionnaire.
items.picture: The clerk at the international office slides a form and a pen across the counter to Emma with a polite gesture.
Emma writes her home address on the form; a thought bubble shows her family's small terraced house in Ireland with a red front door.

items.text: Podpíšte sa tu, prosím. = Please sign here.
items.picture: The clerk at the international office points to the line at the bottom of the form; Emma signs her name with a flourish.

items.text: Ako sa vám páčila konferencia? = How did you like the conference?
items.picture: After the last talk, Emma meets pani Horváthová in the conference foyer; they shake hands, and pani Horváthová, looking proud, asks her how she liked the conference.
